title: When the Hymn Breaks
author: Isandro Crane
blurb: Ines Thornbury, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
